source_records.title: New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains
source_records.read_scope: Complete October 10 GitHub Changelog announcement, including model selection, Fix diagnostic entrypoint, MCP autostart disable option, account/session reliability changes and IDE version deprecation.
verified_main_facts: Enterprise-managed settings can set the default model for new agent conversations but preserve the explicit model picker.
A diagnostic Fix action initiates inline Copilot chat, using agent mode where supported and ask mode otherwise.
An MCP option disables automatic server startup for Copilot and Claude.
JetBrains 2025.1 is no longer supported; 2025.2 or later is required.

source_records.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
source_records.read_scope: Full October 6 OpenAI primary research feature, task formation, contracting approval example, 11-task scoring table, model-comparison caveats, synthetic training methodology and footnotes about estimated task times and data.
verified_main_facts: Researchers defined 11 contracting tasks across procurement, commercial and legal operations with 8–50 criteria per task.
Research scores were GPT-6 Astra 55.0% and GPT-5.6 Sol 41.6% at different selected reasoning settings.
Simulated estimated time per attempt was 19.2 versus 37.0 minutes, not measured customer time savings.
Training tasks used filtered public EDGAR contract material rather than nonpublic customer contracts.

reading_time_evidence.caveat: Editorial approximate reading time, not measured reading session

source_records.freshness_reason: October 6 primary research provides a uniquely concrete 11-task, 8–50-criterion evaluation method for complex computer use, not replicated by the fresher general announcements; within the permitted seven-day fallback.
source_records.limitations: Small 11-task simulated research evaluation, not measured workplace speed

source_records.title: Welcome to Gemini at Work 2026: Introducing the Gemini agent
source_records.read_scope: Complete Thomas Kurian Gemini at Work October 8 keynote article: unified agent and coworker roles, agent/subagent identity, four memory types, registry of tools and skills, Workspace assistance, analytics, sector specializations, sandbox/network gateway, authorization and budget controls.
verified_main_facts: The announcement describes a single Gemini agent that handles multi-step tasks across Workspace and third-party systems.
Tools, modular skills, enterprise context and multiple memory types are described as complementary agent ingredients.
Dedicated coworker and sub-agent identities are described with scoped data access.
Google describes fine-grained authorization, Agent Sandbox, Agent Gateway network enforcement and auditing; performance metrics are vendor claims.

source_records.title: 83% of Agent Skills have no license
source_records.read_scope: Complete October 10 SkillMD registry analysis: survey denominators, sampling query boundaries, license normalization table, repository-license caveat, frontmatter example, SPDX and lint suggestions.
verified_main_facts: SkillMD counted 901,653 of 1,081,266 indexed public skills (83.4%) with no license field in SKILL.md frontmatter.
It did not check a repository-level LICENSE file; absence of frontmatter does not establish absence of permission.
Different free-text variants of MIT/Apache terms require normalization.
It recommends SPDX-compatible identifiers and a lint rule for missing license metadata.

reading_time_evidence.caveat: Editorial approximate reading time, not measured reading session

source_records.limitations: Missing license field is not proof the repository lacks a license

source_records.title: Empowering SMBs to do more with Gemini
source_records.read_scope: Complete Sharon Prosser October 8 SMB article: announced agent availability status, small-business role examples, connector/model/cost controls, named customer case categories, support-document and marketing use cases and recommended learning resources.
verified_main_facts: Google positions the Gemini agent for SMB roles such as bookkeeper, inventory manager, marketing consultant and project manager.
The announcement describes connectors for business tools, contextual continuity, model routing and project-level billing caps.
The new Gemini agent was in early access for SMB customers as of October 8, not broadly available to everyone.
Named SMB customer efficiency figures are vendor-provided case claims.
